messages:
nina: Heads-up: the forecasting pipeline is undercounting GPU hours for eu-west since ~00:00 UTC. Dashboard shows ~30% drop vs expected based on raw usage. This will skew capacity forecasts for next week (holiday spike).

raj: Any errors in the ingest logs? which job?

nina: The `usage-aggregator` job. Saw a bunch of consumer errors in the Kafka client: `MalformedRecordException` and then the job falls back to skipping entire batch. Sample from logs:
```
2026-03-18T00:12:04Z ERROR usage-aggregator consumer[eu-1]: MalformedRecordException at offset 1234567, skipping partition
2026-03-18T00:12:04Z WARN  usage-aggregator batch[42]: batch drop: 42 msgs, topic=usage-raw-eu, reason=deserialization error
```

nina: Also noticed a new metric `gpu_hours_v2` was added to the metrics pipeline yesterday. It looks like the aggregator only reads `gpu_hours_v1` and when `v2` appears in the payload it trips the strict JSON parser.

eng-pipeline-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1123 -> usage-aggregator-eu-undercount. Pager duty: on-call is raj.

raj: OK assigning myself. First pass: can you paste an example payload that fails?

nina: Here is a redacted failing message (one-liner JSONL). Note the stray newline inside the nested `meta.notes` field which seems to be cause: 
```
{"instance":"i-0a1b2c3","gpu_hours":2.5,"meta":{"notes":"job started\ncompleted with warnings"},"version":"gpu_hours_v2"}
```

sam: This is the issue — we tightened the ingest JSONL parser for strictness last deploy (feature flag `ingest-strict-json=true`). Newline inside a JSON string should be escaped, but upstream SDK wrote raw newlines. Quick mitigation: flip the flag to false to restore permissive parsing and restart `usage-aggregator` consumer group.

sam: Command to toggle via feature service (prod):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://features.redwood-inference.internal/api/flags/ingest-strict-json -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

sam: Then restart the deployment: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/usage-aggregator-eu`

leah: That will stop the immediate drop but we still need a backfill to fix historical missed records and to reconcile forecasts. Suggest a targeted replay for eu partition offsets between 1230000-1240000. Use the replay tool that replays raw topic into the stable parser and writes to `usage-processed-eu-backfill`. Command: 
```
replay_ingest --topic usage-raw-eu --from-offset 1230000 --to-offset 1240000 --out-topic usage-processed-eu-backfill --parser permissive
```

leah: Also note: metrics team wants to preserve both `gpu_hours_v1` and `v2` mapping. We'll emit a shim transform that maps v2->v1 for now.

nina: ETA for toggle + restart? we should aim to have permissive parsing up in 15m to stop additional drops. Backfill can run in off-peak window tonight.

raj: I'll flip the flag and restart now. I'll also create a short playbook entry in #runbooks.

ops-bot: Reminder: changing parser may affect billing normalization. Please notify billing@redwood before backfill.

nina: Good catch. I'll loop in billing. Also adding dashboard checklist: mark `gpu_hours_estimated` with a note and pause any automated capacity-scaling alerts until after reconciliation.

leah: After backfill completes, we'll run a quick reconciliation query `SELECT sum(gpu_hours) FROM usage_aggregates WHERE region='eu-west' AND day='2026-03-18'` and compare to raw samples. If delta < 1% we call it green.

raj: Backfill plan: run replay at 02:00 UTC, throttle 200 msgs/s, estimate 2 hours. Post backfill we'll run reconciliation and then kick off a forecast re-run to update Dedicated capacity projections. I'll update ops tickets with exact offsets.

nina: Action items: 1) raj toggles flag + restart (owner: raj, ETA: +15m). 2) leah prepares replay job and test mapping (owner: leah, ETA: EOD). 3) nina notifies billing and pauses auto-scale alerts (owner: nina, ETA: +10m). 4) sam will QA the parser fix and propose a safer deploy (owner: sam, ETA: tomorrow AM).

eng-pipeline-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress.

raj: Done with flag flip and restart, logs show consumer rejoining and no new MalformedRecordExceptions. Monitoring dashboards now show ingestion count returning to expected rates. Starting a dry-run of replay in staging to verify transforms.

nina: Thanks team. After backfill and forecast rerun we should update capacity forecast with new holiday uplift numbers; ops will need to sign off before purchasing additional reserved capacity.

ops-bot: Noted. I'll create a capacity review item once forecast results are in.
